Package frc.robot.subsystems.shooter

Class ShooterConstants.HoodConstants

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.shooter.ShooterConstants.HoodConstants
Enclosing class:
ShooterConstants
public static final class ShooterConstants.HoodConstants extends Object
Constants for the hood mechanism, which adjusts the launch angle.

The hood is driven by a single TalonFX motor with a 155:15 gear reduction. Position is measured by a CANcoder (absolute, for calibration) and the motor's integrated encoder (fast, for closed-loop control after calibrate() runs).

Software limits are 0.0â€“0.065 rotations (hood-axis). The CANcoder magnet offset is TBD until the hood is physically assembled and zeroed in Stage 8-3.
